NARRATIVE SUMMARY
Found 1125 DNR registry wells within 2 mi of the point (all statistics below use only those wells).
Among 830 wells with lithology intervals and/or chunk vein/rock fields (`vein_size_ft`, `gravel_thickness_ft`, `rock_start_ft`, `depth_bedrock`): 0% show three or more sand/gravel/drift intervals (≥1′ each), 96% show exactly one, 0% show two, and 4% show none by parsed log + vein thickness rules.
96% of those wells have at least one water-bearing sand/gravel interval by text rules; 4% have gravel-like intervals flagged but none matched the water-bearing heuristic (re-check raw logs for borderline wording).
Registry aquifer field (where present): 29% unconsolidated/sand/gravel, 2% bedrock/limestone/dolomite, 69% estimated location, 0% other/uncategorized (9 wells with blank aquifer in this radius).
38% of wells with lithology logged a rock top. Of those, 89% drilled sand/gravel before rock — rock tops here run 10–177 ft.
By registry aquifer / notes flags, no dry-hole records appeared in this slice (still verify on-site).
Among 869 wells with a parseable pump/test GPM field: 20% are under 10 GPM, 76% fall 10–25 GPM, 4% report over 25 GPM (avg 14.5 GPM across those wells). Across all 1125 wells in the radius, 23% have no GPM in the export (older records or missing pump fields).
Among 292 sand/gravel (unconsolidated) wells with GPM: 23% under 10 GPM, 70% at 10–25 GPM, 7% over 25 GPM (avg 15.1 GPM).
Among 24 bedrock/rock wells with GPM: 25% under 10 GPM, 71% at 10–25 GPM, 4% over 25 GPM (avg 12.3 GPM).
Median depth for over 25 GPM wells (99 ft) is not deeper than for 25 GPM or below (101 ft) in this slice — treat yield–depth coupling as weak until more tests are in the export.
Median completed depth in the radius: 100 ft (from registry depth / construction fields).

Methodology & limits
Official DNR registry + WellLogs-derived lithology only; not a guarantee for any new hole.
Percentages are descriptive for the loaded chunk set — widen radius or refresh data to reduce sampling noise.
Vein-style counts use merged lithology when possible, else raw intervals, with flexible depth fields; sand/gravel intervals ≥1′ thick. When intervals are missing, **vein_size_ft / gravel_thickness_ft** (ETL) count as at least one gravel-like interval if ≥1′. **rock_start_ft / depth_bedrock** inform rock-top and aquifer inference. Aquifer mix fills blanks via those signals + lithology + completed depth.
The well viewer modal may still show raw chunk lithology strings.
